daily_reality.typical_workday: See 15-25 patients daily for examinations, cleanings supervision, fillings, crowns, extractions, and other procedures. Morning huddle with staff to review schedule. Patient exams with hygienist handoffs. Procedure blocks for restorative work. Administrative time for treatment planning, reviewing X-rays, and documentation. Practice owners also handle business operations, staff management, and marketing.
key_documents: Insurance claim forms (ADA dental claim form)
daily_reality.deadlines: State license renewal cycles. DEA registration renewal. Continuing education credits (varies by state, typically 30-60 hours biennially). Insurance claim submission deadlines. Lab case turnaround times. OSHA compliance training annual updates.
daily_reality.seasonality: Year-end insurance benefit rush (November-December). Back-to-school season for child dental visits. Summer tends to be busier for elective procedures. Holiday periods typically slower.

laws_and_standards: Dental Compact (2026 operational rollout) — interstate practice
regulatory.licensing: DDS or DMD degree from ADA-accredited dental school (4 years post-college). National Board Dental Examinations (NBDE/INBDE). State or regional clinical licensing examination. State dental license required to practice. DEA registration for prescribing. Continuing education required for renewal. Dental Compact (2026) allows cross-state practice in participating states.
regulatory.penalties: State board disciplinary actions (suspension, revocation). Malpractice liability. OSHA fines for infection control violations. DEA penalties for controlled substance violations. Insurance fraud prosecution. Advertising regulation violations.

abbreviations: DMD - Doctor of Medicine in Dentistry
CEREC - Chairside Economical Restoration of Esthetic Ceramics

fears: Staffing crisis (62% report hiring as #1 concern)
career_psychology.motivation: Practice ownership and entrepreneurship; helping patients with tangible results; good work-life balance potential; high income for practice owners ($320k+ average). Practice owners earned $320,316 in 2024 (up 10%).
career_psychology.burnout: Burnout is a significant and growing concern. ADA launched new CE course 'Putting Your Oxygen Mask on First' in March 2026 for mental health. Higher cost of supplies and lower income requiring more hours. Staffing shortages reduced practice capacity ~10% nationally. 47% of associates considering job change. Physical strain from repetitive positioning.

conferences: Chicago Dental Society Midwinter Meeting - February
Greater New York Dental Meeting - November

market.job_count_estimate: About 155,000 dentists in the US. BLS projects 4% growth with ~4,500 openings/year. Two-thirds work in group practices. DSO affiliation reached 16.1% in 2024. HRSA projects 6% increase in dentist supply through 2030, concentrated in metro areas.
market.work_arrangements: Private practice (solo, group, or DSO-affiliated). Hospital-based dentistry. Community health centers. Academic positions. Flexible scheduling is common. Part-time options available. Growing telehealth for consultations.
trends: Dental Compact launching 2026 for interstate practice
